NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed two new commits: one raising `max-width` to 15em, and one changing `font-weight` animation and adding an end-of-file newline. They also updated the description with new screenshots and a comparison to the other open PRs.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description now compares this PR to #39049, #39829 and #39768 and explains why it uses `em` |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots now use a long repeated name, and the limit was raised from 150px to 15em |
| ❌  | The fix was added as separate "fix:" and "css(reactions):" commits instead of being folded into the original commit |
| ❌  | The `font-weight` animation change is unrelated to the issue and makes the diff bigger (+59/-29) |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to clean up the commits and drop the unrelated change.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the screenshots and the comparison with the other PRs. Before this can be reviewed, please squash the "fix:" and "css(reactions):" commits into the main commit (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)) and drop the unrelated `font-weight` change so the diff only covers this issue.
```
